:resource.aws_eks_addon.aws_ebs_csi_driver waits for nodes but not :resource.null_resource.create_calico_installation. With aws-node removed, the EBS CSI controller needs the Calico CNI installation to obtain pod networking and become healthy; otherwise add-on creation can race CNI setup or time out. Order it after the Calico installation (and ensure Calico readiness).

:resource.null_resource.create_calico_installation configures Calico as the EKS CNI, but can run concurrently with :resource.null_resource.delete_daemonset. Order removal of the aws-node CNI before enabling its Calico replacement to avoid competing CNI configuration during migration.
